meta.protocol: Same as scripts/evaluate_policy_comparison.py, with the relational scorer + fusion artifact explicitly pinned to 'gcn' via src/relational_pin.py instead of the ambient FusionEngine()/GNNScorer() default, which silently became M6-fitted-fusion-with-GCN-scores after the 2026-09-07 deployment. Historical results/policy_comparison/metrics.json is NOT modified by this run -- written separately here.

finding.P1_P2_P6_static_policies: Close to historical (within ~0.002-0.01 macro-F1) -- these have no trained-artifact dependency, only s_sec/s_proc threshold rules. The residual gap is run-to-run wall-clock jitter: verified non-deterministic -- repeated calls to this GCN-pinned build_triples() produce different raw s_sec/s_proc values run-to-run (same code, same pin) because GNNScorer.score()'s active-neighbour window is wall-clock (time.time()) based, not a controlled replay clock. See the clock-alignment finding.
finding.P5_adaptive_bandit: STABLE and reproducible across repeated runs (0.5132, verified 3x) but differs from the historical 0.5271 by more than the P1/P2/P6 jitter magnitude. This is NOT explained by scoring-input jitter -- it reflects that models/adaptive_pdp_qtable.json itself was retrained during the M6 deployment commit (3c827e8) via train_adaptive_pdp.py, which has the identical GNNScorer()+FusionEngine()-ambient-default bug (GCN scores paired with M6-fitted fusion at training time). The saved Q-table's bucket/action values no longer correspond to a genuine GCN-only training run. Per objective 9D and the user's explicit decision NOT to retrain the policy artifact in this pass, no corrected P5 number is reported here -- this is recorded as an open finding, not silently fixed.

m6_arm: INVALID COMPARATOR -- not attempted. There is no M6-trained policy artifact: train_adaptive_pdp.py was not corrected/retrained in this pass (explicit user decision). Scoring the current (GCN-era-trained-then-corrupted) Q-table against M6-derived Process Trust it was never calibrated on would not be a methodologically valid GCN-vs-M6 policy comparison, so no M6 number is reported for objective 9D.
